summary: Apply international gender commitments to policy review, budgeting and reporting. Explore the five-day course and build practical review tools.
lede: International gender law and policy links legal commitments to policy decisions, implementation and accountability. For gender policy specialists, legal advisers and programme leads, this training supports reviewing policies and turning commitments into practical actions and evidence. Participants practise treaty interpretation, gender impact assessment and gender-responsive budget review, then select indicators and organize evidence for monitoring and reporting.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who interpret international gender commitments or need to turn them into policy, programmes, budgets and evidence. It is designed for roles that work directly with legal obligations, gender equality measures or institutional reporting.
audience: Women, Peace and Security Programme Officers
prerequisites: Working familiarity with policy development, legal analysis or programme monitoring is expected. No coding or programming is required.
